scope.adaptive: replans from executed positions and received data at sample epochs
scope.disturbance: drift_strength: velocity tracking-command std m/s for holonomic, capped before constraint control; yaw-rate std rad/s for USV; no unmodeled post-control wind
scope.gp: exact, fixed hyperparameters; finite evaluation grid
scope.greedy: open-loop nominal-information route; assumes all scheduled samples succeed
scope.planned_variance: nominal receipt at previewed endpoints; not a guarantee
scope.planning: finite targets; USV endpoint rollouts; joint sequential fantasy gains
scope.safety: sampled piecewise-linear motion checked by common displacement backtracking
scope.usv: turn-rate-limited kinematic unicycle; zero-speed yaw allowed; no hydrodynamics
